summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K (Argentine 'Relevant Event' notice to CNV/BYMA/MAE) disclosing open-market purchases of its own treasury shares, the US-equivalent of an issuer share buyback. On 2026-11-02 CPSA acquired 120,000 ordinary shares (1 vote each, AR$1 par) on BYMA at an average price of AR$1,731.33, for a total of AR$207,760,631, settling 2026-11-03; no NYSE purchases. Buys stayed under 25% of the prior 90-business-day average daily volume. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch buyback pace, treasury-share resale/overhang and ADR pricing.
